note: GH-004 use hybrid channel: static metadata naming absolute release asset URLs on a different origin. src/channels/install.zig treats an absolute URL as-is and a relative one against the channel base, so a hybrid channel is not a special case - and the test compares the artifacts rather than the routes, asserting the hybrid install produced the identical digest the static install produced. The second half is the offline rerun: after both installs, a rerun with reuse_verified issues no requests at all, asserted against the fixtures' own request counters, so offline is measured rather than promised, and the metadata document is re-imported into the store during that rerun to show a store write is not a network request. Fault proof: breaking relative URL resolution makes the hybrid install fail and the digest comparison never run (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
